clearConfirm.message: Delete all sessions, snapshots, screenshots, jobs, and preferences?

extensionDescription.message: Collects local runtime layout evidence from the current page after an explicit user action.

privacyWarning.message: Screenshots may contain sensitive page information. Review the page before enabling.

retainAfterExport.message: Retain large capture data after export

textPreviewWarning.message: Text previews may contain page content. Values from form controls are never collected, and previews are redacted and length-limited.

guideIntro.message: A practical explanation of every screen, option, status, and exported file.

pageStatusHelp.message: Confirms that the active tab is a normal HTTP or HTTPS page that can receive temporary access.

sessionHelp.message: A session groups several viewport observations of the same page or review task.

captureHelp.message: Records one factual snapshot of the current DOM and viewport. The label is descriptive only.

reviewHelp.message: Package integrity describes file correctness. Capture completeness describes whether bounded limits omitted evidence.

exportHelp.message: Runs schema, canonical JSON, checksum, reference, identity, and manifest checks before downloading the ZIP.

privacyAlwaysExcluded.message: form values, cookies, history, URL query, and URL fragment excluded

selectSessionFirst.message: Create or select a session first.

captureTimeout.message: Capture status timed out. Reopen the panel to inspect the persisted job.

reasonDepthLimit.message: Maximum DOM depth was reached. Use Deep DOM when appropriate.

reasonElementLimit.message: The configured element budget was reached.

reasonScanLimit.message: The bounded DOM scan budget was reached.

reasonIdentityCollision.message: One or more identity candidates were ambiguous.

reasonPartialIdentity.message: One or more elements had lower-confidence identity evidence.

reasonGeometry.message: A detached element or non-finite geometry was omitted.

reasonScreenshot.message: The optional screenshot failed; JSON evidence was preserved.

profileHelp.message: Standard is faster. Deep DOM is useful for deeply nested Elementor pages.

optionsIntro.message: Control capture coverage and privacy. Safe defaults are recommended for most pages.

redactionHelp.message: Strict removes the most identity metadata. Diagnostic retains more bounded technical identifiers.

screenshotHelp.message: Captures only the currently visible viewport. Disabled by default because pixels may be sensitive.

hiddenHelp.message: Includes elements hidden directly or by an ancestor. When disabled, effectively hidden descendants are excluded while traversal remains bounded.

pathHelp.message: When disabled, raw locator path facts are withheld and only privacy-sensitive pseudonymous locator hashes remain. Query strings, fragments, and credentials are never included.

titleHelp.message: Page titles may reveal private content. Leave disabled unless needed for matching.

colorsHelp.message: Adds allowlisted color facts such as text, background, and border colors.

textPreviewHelp.message: Form values and contenteditable text are excluded. Remaining previews are redacted and length-limited.

retentionHelp.message: When disabled, snapshots and screenshots are removed from extension storage after a successful export.

advancedLimitsHelp.message: These limits prevent unbounded traversal and oversized snapshots. Select Custom to edit element and depth limits.

pageEvidenceCardHelp.message: Shows the rendered page separately from imported WordPress source documents. Browser binding is preliminary evidence, not Python final correlation.

sourceContextNotImported.message: Not imported; browser-only capture remains valid

structureSummary.message: Structure: $SOURCESECTIONS$ source sections · $RUNTIMESECTIONS$ runtime sections · $CONTAINERS$ runtime containers · $WIDGETMARKERS$ widget markers · $SOURCEWIDGETS$ source widgets · $REGIONS$ regions

reasonReadinessUnstable.message: Capture readiness was unstable; inspect readiness facts.

exportPreflightIntro.message: Review evidence coverage before creating the local ZIP. Warnings do not change facts or run analysis rules.

preflightBlockingWithRuntimeFallback.message: The Minimum Python Feed cannot be exported yet. Return to capture or export the current facts as Runtime Evidence.

preflightBlockingNoFallback.message: This export cannot continue until the blocking requirements are resolved.

preflightWarningSourceContext.message: Source Context is missing; final source/runtime correlation remains unavailable.

preflightWarningSingleViewport.message: Only one measured viewport is available; responsive comparison remains insufficient.

preflightWarningHidden.message: Hidden elements were excluded from every observation.

preflightWarningImages.message: One or more images were incomplete when captured.

preflightBlockingNoObservations.message: Export is blocked because the session has no runtime observations.

preflightBlockingCaptureInProgress.message: Export is blocked while a capture is in progress.

preflightBlockingSessionFailed.message: Export is blocked because the session is in a failed state.

prepareFullDocumentImagesHelp.message: Optionally performs a bounded scroll sweep and restores the original position. It may trigger page side effects and is disabled by default.

viewportProfileHelp.message: The requested profile is provenance only. The collector always records the measured viewport.

exportPythonFeed.message: Validate and export minimum Python feed

preflightBlockingSourceRequired.message: Minimum Python feed requires the imported WordPress Source Context attached to this session.

preflightBlockingSourceIncompatible.message: The imported Source Context is not confirmed or its hash/document identity does not match the session.

preflightBlockingObservations.message: Minimum Python feed requires at least three runtime observations.

preflightBlockingDistinctWidths.message: Minimum Python feed requires at least three distinct measured viewport widths.

preflightBlockingProfiles.message: Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile requested profiles must all be captured.

preflightBlockingPageMismatch.message: All observations must have the same runtime page fingerprint.

preflightBlockingSourceMismatch.message: All observations must reference the same Source Context as the session.

preflightBlockingObservationIndex.message: Observation indexes are invalid, duplicated, or non-contiguous.

captureWorkflowHelp.message: Python Feed mode blocks incomplete or duplicate captures before evidence is written.

feedStepDesktop.message: Capture Desktop at a distinct width

feedStepExport.message: Validate and export the Python Feed

runtimeEvidenceCaptureAvailable.message: Runtime Evidence capture is available. Duplicate widths are allowed in this mode.

pythonFeedCaptureAvailable.message: This viewport is valid for the next Minimum Python Feed observation.

feedGuardSourceRequired.message: Import and confirm the matching WordPress Source Context before capturing.

feedGuardSourceIncompatible.message: The selected Source Context does not match this session.

feedGuardDuplicateWidth.message: Resize the target page. This measured viewport width already exists in the session.

feedGuardDuplicateProfile.message: Choose a profile that has not already been captured in this session.

feedGuardRequiredProfile.message: Minimum Python Feed accepts Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile profiles only.

feedGuardPageMismatch.message: The current page does not match the page already captured in this session.

feedGuardCanonicalScroll.message: Return the target page to scroll position 0 before capturing a Python Feed observation.

feedGuardPageNotVisible.message: The target page must be visible before Python Feed capture.

feedGuardPagePrerendering.message: The target page is prerendering and cannot be captured yet.

feedGuardAdminBar.message: WordPress Admin Bar evidence is present or ambiguous. Use a frontend view without the toolbar.

feedGuardElementorEditor.message: Elementor editor preview is not a canonical published-frontend capture environment.

feedGuardIframe.message: Python Feed capture must run in the top-level page, not inside an iframe.

feedGuardImagesNotReady.message: One or more images in the current viewport are unresolved after the bounded readiness wait.

feedGuardWorkflowModeMismatch.message: This session is locked to a different capture workflow.

preflightBlockingCanonicalScroll.message: One or more observations were not captured at canonical scroll position 0.

preflightBlockingPageNotVisible.message: One or more observations were captured while the page was not visible.

preflightBlockingPagePrerendering.message: One or more observations were captured while the page was prerendering.

preflightBlockingAdminBar.message: WordPress Admin Bar evidence is present or ambiguous in one or more observations.

preflightBlockingElementorEditor.message: Elementor editor preview was present in one or more observations.

preflightBlockingIframe.message: One or more observations were captured inside an iframe.

preflightBlockingImagesNotReady.message: One or more viewport images remained unresolved after the bounded readiness wait.

preflightBlockingWorkflowMode.message: The session workflow mode is inconsistent with this export.

preflightBlockingStorageBudget.message: The session evidence exceeds the deterministic local export budget.

preflightBlockingReadinessError.message: Export is blocked because one or more captures ended with a readiness error. Capture the affected viewport again before exporting.
